cards.title: Charts slide/overlap after pinning+unpinning the copilot
cards.notes: FIXED, deployed, founder-verified (charts stay put after page switching). Real trigger wasn't the copilot padding (already guarded) — it was page switching: react-grid-layout remounts per page while the grid's col count updated a frame LATE, so a wide page mounted against the previous page's cols and RGL's correctBounds clamped the right charts leftward on top of the others; the next drag-stop then persisted those clamped positions wholesale. cols/width are now derived synchronously from (layout, host width), so a remount can never see mismatched cols.

cards.title: Quotes Bugs
cards.notes: FIXED + DEPLOYED (backend restarted + frontend rebuilt on serv 2026-07-04 eve; health green, Schwab token fresh). Root causes: (1) phone blanks = Schwab bar-fetch failures swallowed → /api/watchlist/market returned 200 + empty quotes → mobile cache replaced wholesale (web's additive merge masked it as 'frozen'); now a total-batch miss returns 502 + error log, clients keep last-good data (+regression test). (2) Chart ignored ext_price/market_session while watchlist prefers it off-hours; chart now draws a dashed 'ext' price line during pre/post/overnight. (3) Mobile watchlist merges quotes additively like web. REMAINING: phone bundle refresh (mobile merge fix rides that), and eyeball the dashed ext line once the overnight session opens Sun 20:00 ET. Positions-widget price (broker snapshot, Schwab derived marketValue/qty on 20s poll) is a separate smaller divergence — flag if it bugs you.
